sys_remote_update_set.description: Overview: Adds a Dell Warranty Guided Setup wizard that lets an admin configure Dell TechDirect credentials, test the OAuth connection and warranty API, review outbound readiness, tune and activate the daily import job, and mark setup complete. Detailed plan: Added a DellWarrantyGuidedSetup script include exposing prerequisite checks, credential write, OAuth token test, warranty API test, job activation guard, whitelisted property writes and setup-state persistence, with every public method gated on the admin role. Exposed those as seven admin-gated Scripted REST routes under /api/global/dell_warranty_setup secured by a rest_endpoint ACL requiring admin. Added dell.warranty.batch_size and dell.warranty.setup.state properties and wired batch size into the existing sync engine with 100 retained as the fallback. Added structural connection and credential aliases plus an http_connection for the Dell base URL, deliberately outside the runtime secret path. Built a seven-step React UI Page wizard at dell_warranty_guided_setup.do using ServiceNow React components, URLSearchParams routing, Horizon design tokens and no external fonts or scripts. Added a Guided Setup application module ordered ahead of the existing six Dell Warranty modules. Reasoning: The classic Guided Setup framework cannot be authored from the global scope on this instance, since gsw_content_group inserts are denied and the framework validation rule aborts them, so the documented React UI Page fallback was used. Credentials are written per instance into the existing basic auth profile rather than carried in the update set, keeping environment-specific secrets out of promotion while the wizard and its structure promote cleanly.
sys_remote_update_set.name: LG-Dell-Warranty-Guided-Setup

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.DellWarrantySync</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Dell TechDirect warranty sync engine. runDaily() performs the tiered daily import; runForTags(tags, force) refreshes specific service tags. Shared by the Dell Warranty Daily Import scheduled job and the Refresh Dell Warranty UI action.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DellWarrantySync</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * DellWarrantySync — Dell TechDirect warranty sync engine
 * =======================================================
 * Single implementation shared by:
 *   - the "Dell Warranty Daily Import" scheduled job  -> runDaily()
 *   - the "Refresh Dell Warranty" UI action on alm_hardware -> runForTags([tag], true)
 *
 * This logic previously lived inline in the scheduled job as an IIFE. It was
 * promoted to a Script Include so the single-asset refresh path could reuse it
 * verbatim instead of forking a second copy of the credential, token, batching,
 * staging and transform code.
 *
 * Pipeline:
 *   a) Read client_id / client_secret from the "Dell TechDirect Warranty API"
 *      basic auth profile. Blank on first install -> warn and exit cleanly.
 *   b) Mint an OAuth client_credentials bearer token from Dell.
 *   c) Collect candidate assets in strict priority order (see _collectCandidates).
 *   d) Call the "Dell Warranty API" REST message in batches of BATCH_SIZE.
 *   e) Insert one u_dell_warranty_stage row per returned item (u_status=Pending),
 *      subject to the same-day duplicate guard.
 *   f) _transformPending(): copy staged values onto the matching asset and
 *      stamp u_dell_last_checked.
 *   g) Fire dell.warranty.import.complete with a run summary (when there is
 *      something to report and a recipient is configured).
 *
 * Notes:
 *  - Dell's payload has NO cost/price fields; none are mapped.
 *  - Asset updates deliberately run with workflow ON so normal alm_hardware
 *    business rules still fire (some extra log noise is accepted).
 *  - Names of the auth profile and REST message are unchanged from the
 *    baseline and must stay that way.
 */
var DellWarrantySync = Class.create()

DellWarrantySync.prototype = {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Constants
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Default/fallback batch size. The LIVE value is read at the call sites
    // from the `dell.warranty.batch_size` property, so an admin can retune
    // batching without a rebuild. 100 is the value that used to be hardcoded,
    // so default behaviour is unchanged.
    BATCH_SIZE: 100, // service tags sent per Dell warranty request (fallback)
    AUTH_PROFILE_NAME: 'Dell TechDirect Warranty API',
    TOKEN_ENDPOINT: 'https://apigtwb2c.us.dell.com/auth/oauth/v2/token',
    REST_MESSAGE: 'Dell Warranty API',
    REST_FUNCTION: 'get',
    STAGE_TABLE: 'u_dell_warranty_stage',
    ASSET_TABLE: 'alm_hardware',
    JOB_TABLE: 'sysauto_script',
    JOB_NAME: 'Dell Warranty Daily Import',
    DISCOVERY_SOURCE: 'Dell TechDirect',
    EVENT_NAME: 'dell.warranty.import.complete',
    HTTP_TIMEOUT: 30000,
    SERVICE_TAG_PATTERN: /^[A-Za-z0-9]{7}$/, // Dell service tag shape

    // Property names (all admin-tunable, no code change required)
    PROP_NOTIFY: 'dell.warranty.notify',
    PROP_STALE_DAYS: 'dell.warranty.stale_days',
    PROP_DAILY_LIMIT: 'dell.warranty.daily_limit',

    initialize: function () {
        this.stats = {
            candidates: 0,
            tier1: 0,
            tier2: 0,
            tier3: 0,
            staged: 0,
            duplicatesSkipped: 0,
            transformOk: 0,
            transformFail: 0,
            errorNoMatch: 0,
            errors: 0,
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // Small helpers
    // ==================================================================

    /** Safe string coercion for GlideElement / null / undefined. */
    _str: function (value) {
        return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
    },

    /** Pick the first non-blank value from the given candidates. */
    _firstNonBlank: function (values) {
        for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            var candidate = this._str(values[i]).trim()
            if (candidate) {
                return candidate
            }
        }
        return ''
    },

    /** Trim a value to a maximum length so wide payloads never break inserts. */
    _clamp: function (value, maxLength) {
        var out = this._str(value)
        return out.length > maxLength ? out.substring(0, maxLength) : out
    },

    /**
     * Read a property as a trimmed string, normalizing "unset" spellings.
     *
     * A `Property({ value: '' })` is materialized by the platform as the
     * LITERAL STRING "null" (confirmed on this instance:
     * dell.warranty.notify installed as "null", not ''). An admin clearing a
     * value by hand can likewise leave "null" or "undefined" behind. Without
     * this guard, `if (recipient)` is true for the string "null" and the job
     * would queue a notification addressed to a recipient named "null".
     */
    _propStr: function (name) {
        var raw = this._str(gs.getProperty(name, '')).trim()
        if (!raw || raw.toLowerCase() === 'null' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'undefined') {
            return ''
        }
        return raw
    },

    /** Read an integer property, falling back to a default. */
    _intProp: function (name, fallback) {
        var raw = parseInt(this._propStr(name), 10)
        return isNaN(raw) || raw <= 0 ? fallback : raw
    },

    /**
     * Normalize a Dell date ("2019-05-16T05:00:00Z", "2019-05-16", ...) to the
     * yyyy-MM-dd form expected by a glide_date column. Returns '' when unusable.
     */
    _toDateOnly: function (value) {
        var raw = this._str(value).trim()
        if (!raw) {
            return ''
        }
        var match = raw.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/)
        return match ? match[1] : ''
    },

    /**
     * Dell asset test: display name of the model OR the vendor contains "dell".
     * Reference sys_ids are deliberately NOT compared - display name only.
     */
    _isDellAsset: function (gr) {
        var model = this._str(gr.model.getDisplayValue()).toLowerCase()
        var vendor = this._str(gr.vendor.getDisplayValue()).toLowerCase()
        return model.indexOf('dell') > -1 || vendor.indexOf('dell') > -1
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // a) Credentials
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Read client_id (username) and client_secret (password) from the basic
     * auth profile. Returns null when the profile is missing or incomplete.
     */
    _readCredentials: function () {
        var profile = new GlideRecord('sys_auth_profile_basic')
        profile.addQuery('name', this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME)
        profile.setLimit(1)
        profile.query()

        if (!profile.next()) {
            gs.warn(
                "Dell Warranty Sync: credentials not configured - populate the 'Dell TechDirect Warranty API' basic auth profile"
            )
            return null
        }

        var clientId = this._str(profile.getValue('username')).trim()
        var clientSecret = ''

        // password is a password2 (encrypted) field: ask the element to decrypt
        // it, then fall back to the display value, then to a GlideEncrypter.
        try {
            clientSecret = this._str(profile.password.getDecryptedValue()).trim()
        } catch (decryptError) {
            clientSecret = ''
        }
        if (!clientSecret) {
            clientSecret = this._str(profile.getDisplayValue('password')).trim()
        }
        if (!clientSecret) {
            try {
                clientSecret = this._str(new GlideEncrypter().decrypt(profile.getValue('password'))).trim()
            } catch (encrypterError) {
                clientSecret = ''
            }
        }

        if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
            gs.warn(
                "Dell Warranty Sync: credentials not configured - populate the 'Dell TechDirect Warranty API' basic auth profile"
            )
            return null
        }

        return { clientId: clientId, clientSecret: clientSecret }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // b) OAuth token
    // ==================================================================

    /** POST client_credentials to Dell and return the access_token, or null. */
    _requestAccessToken: function (credentials) {
        try {
            var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2()
            request.setEndpoint(this.TOKEN_ENDPOINT)
            request.setHttpMethod('POST')
            request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
            request.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json')
            request.setRequestBody(
                'grant_type=client_credentials' +
                    '&client_id=' +
                    encodeURIComponent(credentials.clientId) +
                    '&client_secret=' +
                    encodeURIComponent(credentials.clientSecret)
            )
            request.setHttpTimeout(this.HTTP_TIMEOUT)

            var response = request.execute()
            var status = response.getStatusCode()

            if (status != 200) {
                // Never log the response body here - it can carry token material.
                gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: token request failed with HTTP ' + status)
                return null
            }

            var token = this._str(JSON.parse(response.getBody()).access_token).trim()
            if (!token) {
                gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: token response contained no access_token')
                return null
            }
            return token
        } catch (tokenException) {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: token request exception - ' + tokenException)
            return null
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // c) Candidate selection
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Collect up to DAILY_LIMIT distinct Dell service tags in STRICT PRIORITY
     * ORDER. Earlier tiers consume the daily limit first, so a large backlog can
     * never be starved by routine refresh traffic.
     *
     *   TIER 1 - BACKLOG (highest priority)
     *            warranty_expiration IS EMPTY
     *            Assets that have never been enriched. Processed first because
     *            they contribute nothing to any warranty KPI until they are.
     *            Measured pool on this instance: 56.
     *
     *   TIER 2 - REFRESH
     *            warranty_expiration within the next 90 days
     *            Coverage about to lapse; Dell may have recorded a renewal, so
     *            these are re-read to catch extensions before they show up as
     *            false "expiring" alerts. Measured pool: 22.
     *
     *   TIER 3 - STALE RE-CHECK (lowest priority)
     *            u_discovery_source = 'Dell TechDirect'
     *            AND (u_dell_last_checked IS EMPTY OR older than STALE_DAYS)
     *            Keeps already-enriched assets from drifting. Only applies to
     *            assets the import itself has touched, so it cannot pull in
     *            unrelated hardware. Default STALE_DAYS = 30.
     *
     * Serial shape (7-char alphanumeric) and the Dell display-name test are
     * enforced in script rather than in the query, because neither can be
     * expressed as an encoded query condition.
     */
    _collectCandidates: function () {
        var dailyLimit = this._intProp(this.PROP_DAILY_LIMIT, 1000)
        var staleDays = this._intProp(this.PROP_STALE_DAYS, 30)

        var tags = []
        var seen = {}
        var self = this

        /** Append tags from one encoded query until the daily limit is reached. */
        function harvest(encodedQuery, tierKey) {
            if (tags.length >= dailyLimit) {
                return
            }
            var asset = new GlideRecord(self.ASSET_TABLE)
            asset.addEncodedQuery(encodedQuery)
            asset.addNotNullQuery('serial_number')
            asset.orderBy('serial_number')
            asset.query()

            while (asset.next()) {
                if (tags.length >= dailyLimit) {
                    break
                }
                self.stats.candidates++

                var serial = self._str(asset.getValue('serial_number')).trim()
                if (!self.SERVICE_TAG_PATTERN.test(serial)) {
                    continue // not a 7-char alphanumeric Dell service tag
                }
                if (!self._isDellAsset(asset)) {
                    continue
                }

                var key = serial.toUpperCase()
                if (seen[key]) {
                    continue // already queued by a higher-priority tier
                }
                seen[key] = true
                tags.push(serial)
                self.stats[tierKey]++
            }
        }

        // TIER 1 - backlog: no warranty date at all.
        harvest('warranty_expirationISEMPTY', 'tier1')

        // TIER 2 - refresh: warranty lapsing within 90 days.
        harvest(
            'warranty_expiration>=javascript:gs.beginningOfToday()' +
                '^warranty_expiration<=javascript:gs.daysAgoEnd(-90)',
            'tier2'
        )

        // TIER 3 - stale re-check: TechDirect-tagged and not checked recently.
        // The OR group leads, per the encoded-query grouping rule, so this reads
        // (last_checked empty OR last_checked < N days ago) AND source=TechDirect.
        harvest(
            'u_dell_last_checkedISEMPTY' +
                '^ORu_dell_last_checked<javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(' +
                staleDays +
                ')' +
                '^u_discovery_source=' +
                this.DISCOVERY_SOURCE,
            'tier3'
        )

        return tags
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // d) Dell warranty call
    // ==================================================================

    /** Call the REST message for one batch of tags. Returns an array of items. */
    _fetchWarranty: function (batch, token) {
        try {
            var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(this.REST_MESSAGE, this.REST_FUNCTION)
            rm.setStringParameterNoEscape('servicetags', batch.join(','))
            rm.setStringParameterNoEscape('authToken', token)
            rm.setHttpTimeout(this.HTTP_TIMEOUT)

            var response = rm.execute()
            var status = response.getStatusCode()

            if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
                gs.error(
                    'Dell Warranty Sync: warranty lookup failed with HTTP ' +
                        status +
                        ' for ' +
                        batch.length +
                        ' service tag(s)'
                )
                this.stats.errors++
                return []
            }

            var parsed = JSON.parse(response.getBody())
            if (!parsed) {
                return []
            }
            // Dell normally returns a bare array; tolerate a wrapped object too.
            if (parsed instanceof Array) {
                return parsed
            }
            if (parsed.AssetWarrantyResponse instanceof Array) {
                return parsed.AssetWarrantyResponse
            }
            return [parsed]
        } catch (lookupException) {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: warranty lookup exception - ' + lookupException)
            this.stats.errors++
            return []
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // e) Staging
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Derive warranty window, support levels and entitlement count from the
     * Dell `entitlements` array. Defensive about missing keys.
     */
    _summarizeEntitlements: function (item) {
        var summary = { start: '', end: '', supportLevels: '', count: 0 }
        var entitlements = item && item.entitlements instanceof Array ? item.entitlements : []
        summary.count = entitlements.length

        var levels = []
        var seenLevels = {}

        for (var i = 0; i < entitlements.length; i++) {
            var entitlement = entitlements[i] || {}

            var start = this._toDateOnly(entitlement.startDate)
            if (start && (!summary.start || start < summary.start)) {
                summary.start = start // earliest start date
            }

            var end = this._toDateOnly(entitlement.endDate)
            if (end && (!summary.end || end > summary.end)) {
                summary.end = end // latest end date
            }

            var level = this._str(entitlement.serviceLevelDescription).trim()
            if (level && !seenLevels[level]) {
                seenLevels[level] = true
                levels.push(level)
            }
        }

        summary.supportLevels = levels.join('|')
        return summary
    },

    /**
     * Same-day duplicate guard (Feature Set 4, item 1).
     *
     * Returns true when a Pending or Transformed staging row already exists for
     * this service tag with today's creation date. Prevents a re-run (or an
     * overlapping manual refresh) from stacking redundant Pending rows that
     * would each re-write the same asset and distort the intake trend.
     *
     * `Error - no match` rows are intentionally NOT counted as duplicates: if a
     * tag failed to match earlier, a later attempt in the same day should still
     * be allowed to stage and retry.
     */
    _hasStageRowToday: function (serviceTag) {
        var stage = new GlideAggregate(this.STAGE_TABLE)
        stage.addQuery('u_service_tag', serviceTag)
        stage.addQuery('u_status', 'IN', 'Pending,Transformed')
        stage.addEncodedQuery('sys_created_on>=javascript:gs.beginningOfToday()')
        stage.addAggregate('COUNT')
        stage.query()
        return stage.next() && parseInt(stage.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) > 0
    },

    /**
     * Insert one staging row for a Dell payload item.
     * `force` bypasses the same-day duplicate guard — used by the UI action,
     * where the click itself is an explicit request to re-read Dell now.
     */
    _insertStageRow: function (item, force) {
        var serviceTag = this._firstNonBlank([item.serviceTag, item.servicetag, item.id])
        if (!serviceTag) {
            gs.warn('Dell Warranty Sync: skipping payload item with no service tag')
            this.stats.errors++
            return
        }

        if (!force && this._hasStageRowToday(serviceTag)) {
            this.stats.duplicatesSkipped++
            return
        }

        var entitlements = this._summarizeEntitlements(item)

        var stage = new GlideRecord(this.STAGE_TABLE)
        stage.initialize()
        stage.setValue('u_service_tag', this._clamp(serviceTag, 40))
        stage.setValue('u_model', this._clamp(this._firstNonBlank([item.productLineDescription, item.productId]), 100))
        stage.setValue(
            'u_system_description',
            this._clamp(this._firstNonBlank([item.machineDescription, item.productLineDescription]), 255)
        )
        stage.setValue('u_product_lob', this._clamp(this._str(item.productLobDescription), 100))
        stage.setValue('u_ship_date', this._toDateOnly(item.shipDate))
        stage.setValue('u_warranty_start', entitlements.start)
        stage.setValue('u_warranty_expiration', entitlements.end)
        stage.setValue('u_support_levels', this._clamp(entitlements.supportLevels, 500))
        stage.setValue('u_entitlement_count', entitlements.count)
        stage.setValue('u_country_code', this._clamp(this._str(item.countryCode), 10))
        stage.setValue('u_status', 'Pending')
        stage.setValue('u_raw_json', this._clamp(JSON.stringify(item), 8000))

        if (stage.insert()) {
            this.stats.staged++
        } else {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: failed to insert staging row for ' + serviceTag)
            this.stats.errors++
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // f) Transform
    // ==================================================================

    /** Build the u_short_description value from the non-blank parts. */
    _buildShortDescription: function (stage) {
        var parts = []
        var candidates = [
            this._str(stage.getValue('u_model')).trim(),
            this._str(stage.getValue('u_system_description')).trim(),
            this._str(stage.getValue('u_product_lob')).trim(),
        ]
        for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
            if (candidates[i]) {
                parts.push(candidates[i])
            }
        }
        return this._clamp(parts.join(' | '), 255)
    },

    /** Find the Dell alm_hardware record whose serial equals the service tag. */
    _findAssetByServiceTag: function (serviceTag) {
        var asset = new GlideRecord(this.ASSET_TABLE)
        asset.addQuery('serial_number', serviceTag)
        asset.query()
        while (asset.next()) {
            if (this._isDellAsset(asset)) {
                return asset
            }
        }
        return null
    },

    /**
     * Copy every Pending staging row onto its matching asset.
     * `tagFilter` (optional array) restricts the transform to specific service
     * tags so the UI action does not sweep up unrelated pending rows.
     */
    _transformPending: function (tagFilter) {
        var stage = new GlideRecord(this.STAGE_TABLE)
        stage.addQuery('u_status', 'Pending')
        if (tagFilter && tagFilter.length) {
            stage.addQuery('u_service_tag', 'IN', tagFilter.join(','))
        }
        stage.query()

        while (stage.next()) {
            var serviceTag = this._str(stage.getValue('u_service_tag')).trim()
            var asset = serviceTag ? this._findAssetByServiceTag(serviceTag) : null

            if (!asset) {
                stage.setValue('u_status', 'Error - no match')
                stage.update()
                this.stats.errorNoMatch++
                continue
            }

            var expiration = this._str(stage.getValue('u_warranty_expiration'))

            asset.setValue('warranty_expiration', expiration)
            asset.setValue('u_warranty_start', this._str(stage.getValue('u_warranty_start')))
            asset.setValue('u_support_levels', this._str(stage.getValue('u_support_levels')))
            asset.setValue('u_entitlement_count', this._str(stage.getValue('u_entitlement_count')))
            asset.setValue('u_product_lob', this._str(stage.getValue('u_product_lob')))
            asset.setValue('u_country_code', this._str(stage.getValue('u_country_code')))
            asset.setValue('u_discovery_source', this.DISCOVERY_SOURCE)
            asset.setValue('u_short_description', this._buildShortDescription(stage))
            // Feature Set 2 — stamp the refresh clock so the stale tier can
            // tell this asset apart from one that has never been checked.
            asset.setValue('u_dell_last_checked', new GlideDateTime().getValue())

            // Audit trail on the asset. Workflow stays ON so standard
            // alm_hardware business rules continue to run.
            asset.work_notes =
                'Dell TechDirect warranty sync: warranty expiration set to ' +
                (expiration || '(none returned)') +
                ' for service tag ' +
                serviceTag +
                '.'

            if (asset.update()) {
                stage.setValue('u_status', 'Transformed')
                stage.update()
                this.stats.transformOk++
            } else {
                gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: failed to update asset for service tag ' + serviceTag)
                this.stats.transformFail++
            }
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // g) Run summary notification
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Approximate count of Dell assets still carrying no warranty date.
     * One GlideAggregate COUNT, so it is cheap. "Approx" because the 7-char
     * service-tag shape test cannot be expressed in an encoded query, so the
     * real candidate count is a subset of this figure.
     */
    _remainingBacklog: function () {
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.ASSET_TABLE)
        agg.addEncodedQuery(
            'u_discovery_source=Dell TechDirect^ORdisplay_nameLIKEDell^ORvendor.nameLIKEdell' +
                '^warranty_expirationISEMPTY'
        )
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT')
        agg.query()
        return agg.next() ? parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0
    },

    /**
     * Fire dell.warranty.import.complete with a run summary.
     *
     * Deliberately quiet: the event is skipped entirely when the run did
     * nothing at all, so an idle instance does not generate a daily empty
     * email. It is also skipped when no recipient is configured, because an
     * event-parm recipient notification with a blank parm1 would produce a
     * notification with nobody to send to.
     */
    _fireSummaryEvent: function () {
        var s = this.stats
        var didSomething =
            s.staged > 0 || s.transformOk > 0 || s.transformFail > 0 || s.errorNoMatch > 0 || s.errors > 0

        if (!didSomething) {
            gs.info('Dell Warranty Sync: nothing to process this run - summary notification suppressed')
            return
        }

        var recipient = this._propStr(this.PROP_NOTIFY)
        if (!recipient) {
            gs.info(
                'Dell Warranty Sync: no recipient configured in ' +
                    this.PROP_NOTIFY +
                    ' - summary notification suppressed (run summary is in the system log)'
            )
            return
        }

        var job = new GlideRecord(this.JOB_TABLE)
        job.addQuery('name', this.JOB_NAME)
        job.setLimit(1)
        job.query()
        if (!job.next()) {
            gs.warn('Dell Warranty Sync: could not locate the job record to attach the summary event to')
            return
        }

        var summary = [
            'Run completed: ' + new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue(),
            'Staged successfully: ' + s.staged,
            'Transform OK: ' + s.transformOk,
            'Transform failed: ' + s.transformFail,
            'Error - no match (this run): ' + s.errorNoMatch,
            'Duplicate same-day rows skipped: ' + s.duplicatesSkipped,
            'Candidates queued: tier1=' + s.tier1 + ' tier2=' + s.tier2 + ' tier3=' + s.tier3,
            'Approx. Dell assets still missing warranty: ' + this._remainingBacklog(),
        ].join('<br/>')

        gs.eventQueue(this.EVENT_NAME, job, recipient, summary)
    },

    /** Emit the run summary to the system log. Always runs. */
    _logSummary: function (label) {
        var s = this.stats
        gs.info(
            'Dell Warranty Sync (' +
                label +
                ') summary: candidates scanned=' +
                s.candidates +
                ', queued tier1=' +
                s.tier1 +
                '/tier2=' +
                s.tier2 +
                '/tier3=' +
                s.tier3 +
                ', staged=' +
                s.staged +
                ', same-day duplicates skipped=' +
                s.duplicatesSkipped +
                ', transformed=' +
                s.transformOk +
                ', transform failed=' +
                s.transformFail +
                ', no match=' +
                s.errorNoMatch +
                ', errors=' +
                s.errors
        )
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // Public entry points
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Process a specific list of service tags.
     * @param tags  array of Dell service tags
     * @param force bypass the same-day duplicate guard (manual refresh)
     * @return the stats object for the run
     */
    runForTags: function (tags, force) {
        try {
            if (!tags || !tags.length) {
                return this.stats
            }

            var credentials = this._readCredentials()
            if (!credentials) {
                return this.stats
            }

            var token = this._requestAccessToken(credentials)
            if (!token) {
                return this.stats
            }

            // Batch size is admin-tunable via dell.warranty.batch_size.
            var batchSize = this._intProp('dell.warranty.batch_size', this.BATCH_SIZE)
            for (var offset = 0; offset < tags.length; offset += batchSize) {
                var batch = tags.slice(offset, offset + batchSize)
                var items = this._fetchWarranty(batch, token)
                for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                    this._insertStageRow(items[i] || {}, force)
                }
            }

            this._transformPending(tags)
        } catch (runException) {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: unexpected failure - ' + runException)
            this.stats.errors++
        }
        return this.stats
    },

    /** Full daily run: tiered candidate selection, staging, transform, summary. */
    runDaily: function () {
        try {
            var credentials = this._readCredentials()
            if (!credentials) {
                return this.stats // graceful exit, not an error
            }

            var token = this._requestAccessToken(credentials)
            if (!token) {
                return this.stats
            }

            var serviceTags = this._collectCandidates()
            gs.info(
                'Dell Warranty Sync: ' +
                    serviceTags.length +
                    ' service tag(s) queued for lookup (tier1=' +
                    this.stats.tier1 +
                    ', tier2=' +
                    this.stats.tier2 +
                    ', tier3=' +
                    this.stats.tier3 +
                    ')'
            )

            // Batch size is admin-tunable via dell.warranty.batch_size.
            var batchSize = this._intProp('dell.warranty.batch_size', this.BATCH_SIZE)
            for (var offset = 0; offset < serviceTags.length; offset += batchSize) {
                var batch = serviceTags.slice(offset, offset + batchSize)
                var items = this._fetchWarranty(batch, token)
                for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                    this._insertStageRow(items[i] || {}, false)
                }
            }

            // Transform everything still Pending, including leftovers from an
            // earlier partial run.
            this._transformPending(null)
        } catch (jobException) {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Sync: unexpected failure - ' + jobException)
            this.stats.errors++
        } finally {
            this._logSummary('daily')
            this._fireSummaryEvent()
        }
        return this.stats
    },

    type: 'DellWarrantySync',
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-14 10:14:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>49fedd86c7bb4f12bc4ac7fb874ae3e9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DellWarrantySync</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_49fedd86c7bb4f12bc4ac7fb874ae3e9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-14 10:14:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.DellWarrantyGuidedSetup</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Admin-only server API for the Dell Warranty guided setup wizard. Provides checkPrerequisites(), getStatus(), saveCredentials(), testConnection(), testWarrantyApi(), setJobActive(), setProperty(), markComplete() and resetSetup(). Every method requires the admin role and returns a structured refusal otherwise. Never returns or logs the Dell client secret.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DellWarrantyGuidedSetup</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * DellWarrantyGuidedSetup — admin-only server API behind the Dell Warranty
 * Guided Setup wizard.
 * ============================================================================
 *
 * WHY THIS EXISTS
 * ---------------
 * The guided experience is delivered as a UI SPA, and every server-side
 * operation it needs lives here, exposed through the "Dell Warranty Guided
 * Setup" Scripted REST API (`/api/global/dell_warranty_setup`). Keeping the
 * logic in a Script Include means the REST resources stay thin (build the
 * instance, call one method, set the body and status) and the same operations
 * remain callable from a background script or a future UI action.
 *
 * SECURITY MODEL
 * --------------
 * EVERY public method starts with `_requireAdmin()`. If the caller is not an
 * admin the method returns the structured refusal
 * `{ok:false, forbidden:true, message:'Requires the admin role.'}` without
 * doing any work, so the REST layer can map it to HTTP 403 and the wizard can
 * render a clear "requires admin" message. The REST endpoints are ALSO gated
 * by a `rest_endpoint` ACL requiring the admin role — that is defence in
 * depth, not a substitute for these checks.
 *
 * SECRET HANDLING
 * ---------------
 * The basic auth profile "Dell TechDirect Warranty API" remains the SINGLE
 * source of truth for the Dell client id / client secret, because the live
 * "Dell Warranty Daily Import" scheduled job reads it. This class writes to it
 * and reads from it, and NEVER:
 *   - returns the client secret (not even masked),
 *   - logs the client secret,
 *   - writes the client secret into the setup-state property,
 *   - echoes a raw HTTP response body that could carry token material.
 * The client id is only ever returned masked (first 4 characters + bullets).
 *
 * BLANK-VALUE NORMALIZATION
 * -------------------------
 * A Fluent `Property({ value: '' })` is materialized by the platform as the
 * LITERAL STRING "null" (confirmed empirically on this instance), and the auth
 * profile's username currently reads back as "null" too. `_str0()` normalizes
 * ''/"null"/"undefined" to blank — the same idea as
 * `DellWarrantySync._propStr()`. Without it, `credentialsConfigured` would be
 * true for an empty profile and the setup state would never read as
 * "not_started".
 */
var DellWarrantyGuidedSetup = Class.create()

DellWarrantyGuidedSetup.prototype = {
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Constants — all names match records that already exist on the instance
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    AUTH_PROFILE_TABLE: 'sys_auth_profile_basic',
    AUTH_PROFILE_NAME: 'Dell TechDirect Warranty API',
    TOKEN_ENDPOINT: 'https://apigtwb2c.us.dell.com/auth/oauth/v2/token',
    REST_MESSAGE: 'Dell Warranty API',
    REST_FUNCTION: 'get',
    STAGE_TABLE: 'u_dell_warranty_stage',
    ASSET_TABLE: 'alm_hardware',
    JOB_TABLE: 'sysauto_script',
    JOB_NAME: 'Dell Warranty Daily Import',
    SYNC_INCLUDE: 'DellWarrantySync',
    APP_ROLE: 'dell_warranty_user',
    CONNECTION_ALIAS: 'Dell TechDirect Warranty',
    DASHBOARD_SYS_ID: 'f7b5d87ca3aa4dbdb9b783a6b38f20fd',
    HTTP_TIMEOUT: 30000,
    SERVICE_TAG_PATTERN: /^[A-Za-z0-9]{7}$/,
    BODY_SNIPPET_MAX: 300,

    /** The eight custom columns the warranty integration added to alm_hardware. */
    ASSET_COLUMNS: [
        'u_warranty_start',
        'u_support_levels',
        'u_entitlement_count',
        'u_product_lob',
        'u_country_code',
        'u_discovery_source',
        'u_short_description',
        'u_dell_last_checked',
    ],

    PROP_STATE: 'dell.warranty.setup.state',
    PROP_DAILY_LIMIT: 'dell.warranty.daily_limit',
    PROP_BATCH_SIZE: 'dell.warranty.batch_size',
    PROP_STALE_DAYS: 'dell.warranty.stale_days',
    PROP_NOTIFY: 'dell.warranty.notify',

    /**
     * setProperty() whitelist. Anything not listed here is refused outright,
     * so the wizard can never be used as a generic sys_properties editor.
     */
    WRITABLE_PROPERTIES: {
        'dell.warranty.daily_limit': 'integer',
        'dell.warranty.batch_size': 'integer',
        'dell.warranty.stale_days': 'integer',
        'dell.warranty.notify': 'string',
    },

    initialize: function () {},

    // ==================================================================
    // Guards and small helpers
    // ==================================================================

    /** Safe string coercion for GlideElement / null / undefined. */
    _str: function (value) {
        return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
    },

    /** Trimmed string with ''/"null"/"undefined" all normalized to blank. */
    _str0: function (value) {
        var raw = this._str(value).trim()
        var lower = raw.toLowerCase()
        return !raw || lower === 'null' || lower === 'undefined' ? '' : raw
    },

    /**
     * Admin gate. Returns the structured refusal object when the caller is not
     * an admin, otherwise null. Every public method calls this FIRST and
     * returns the refusal before doing any work.
     */
    _requireAdmin: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole('admin')) {
            return null
        }
        return { ok: false, forbidden: true, message: 'Requires the admin role.' }
    },

    /** Read an integer property with a fallback. */
    _intProp: function (name, fallback) {
        var raw = parseInt(this._str0(gs.getProperty(name, '')), 10)
        return isNaN(raw) || raw <= 0 ? fallback : raw
    },

    /** One prerequisite row. */
    _check: function (key, label, pass, detail) {
        return { key: key, label: label, status: pass ? 'pass' : 'fail', detail: detail }
    },

    /** True when a row matching the query exists. */
    _exists: function (table, field, value) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table)
        gr.addQuery(field, value)
        gr.setLimit(1)
        gr.query()
        return gr.next()
    },

    /** GlideAggregate COUNT helper used for the staging tallies. */
    _count: function (encodedQuery) {
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.STAGE_TABLE)
        if (encodedQuery) {
            agg.addEncodedQuery(encodedQuery)
        }
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT')
        agg.query()
        return agg.next() ? parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // Setup state (dell.warranty.setup.state)
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Read the setup-state blob DEFENSIVELY. Blank / "null" / unparseable all
     * mean "not started" — see the Property() description for why "null"
     * matters. The blob NEVER contains secret material, only outcomes and
     * timestamps.
     */
    _readState: function () {
        var raw = this._str0(gs.getProperty(this.PROP_STATE, ''))
        if (!raw) {
            return { state: 'not_started' }
        }
        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
            return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : { state: 'not_started' }
        } catch (parseError) {
            gs.warn('Dell Warranty Guided Setup: setup state property was not valid JSON - treating as not started')
            return { state: 'not_started' }
        }
    },

    /** Persist the setup-state blob. Only plain outcome data is ever written. */
    _writeState: function (state) {
        var safe = {
            state: this._str0(state.state) || 'not_started',
            lastConnectionTest: state.lastConnectionTest || null,
            lastApiTest: state.lastApiTest || null,
            completedBy: this._str0(state.completedBy),
            completedOn: this._str0(state.completedOn),
        }
        gs.setProperty(this.PROP_STATE, JSON.stringify(safe))
        return safe
    },

    /** Move the wizard to 'in_progress' unless it is already complete. */
    _markInProgress: function () {
        var state = this._readState()
        if (state.state !== 'complete') {
            state.state = 'in_progress'
            this._writeState(state)
        }
    },

    /** `{ok, ts}` stamp used for the two persisted test results. */
    _stamp: function (ok) {
        return { ok: ok === true, ts: new GlideDateTime().getValue() }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // Credentials
    // ==================================================================

    /** Locate the basic auth profile record, or null. */
    _authProfile: function () {
        var profile = new GlideRecord(this.AUTH_PROFILE_TABLE)
        profile.addQuery('name', this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME)
        profile.setLimit(1)
        profile.query()
        return profile.next() ? profile : null
    },

    /**
     * Decrypt the profile password. Same three-stage fallback
     * DellWarrantySync._readCredentials() uses (element decrypt, display
     * value, GlideEncrypter) so both read paths agree on "configured".
     */
    _decryptSecret: function (profile) {
        var secret = ''
        try {
            secret = this._str(profile.password.getDecryptedValue()).trim()
        } catch (decryptError) {
            secret = ''
        }
        if (!secret) {
            secret = this._str(profile.getDisplayValue('password')).trim()
        }
        if (!secret) {
            try {
                secret = this._str(new GlideEncrypter().decrypt(profile.getValue('password'))).trim()
            } catch (encrypterError) {
                secret = ''
            }
        }
        return this._str0(secret)
    },

    /** `{exists, clientId, hasSecret}`. The secret itself is never returned. */
    _credentialState: function () {
        var profile = this._authProfile()
        if (!profile) {
            return { exists: false, clientId: '', hasSecret: false }
        }
        return {
            exists: true,
            // username currently reads back as the literal string "null" on
            // this instance, hence _str0() rather than a plain trim.
            clientId: this._str0(profile.getValue('username')),
            hasSecret: !!this._decryptSecret(profile),
        }
    },

    /**
     * Mask the client id: at most the first 4 characters, then bullets.
     * Short ids are fully masked rather than partially revealed.
     */
    _maskClientId: function (clientId) {
        var id = this._str0(clientId)
        if (!id) {
            return ''
        }
        return id.length <= 4 ? '••••' : id.substring(0, 4) + '••••'
    },

    /**
     * Cap and scrub an HTTP response body before it is handed back to the
     * wizard. Anything that looks like a token/secret/credential value is
     * replaced BEFORE truncation, so no fragment can leak through the cap.
     */
    _safeSnippet: function (body) {
        var text = this._str(body)
        if (!text) {
            return ''
        }
        text = text.replace(
            /("?(?:access_token|refresh_token|id_token|client_secret|password|secret|authorization)"?\s*[:=]\s*)("?)[^",}\s&]+/gi,
            '$1$2[redacted]'
        )
        text = text.replace(/\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\-]+/gi, 'Bearer [redacted]')
        text = text.replace(/\b[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{40,}\b/g, '[redacted]')
        text = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
        return text.length > this.BODY_SNIPPET_MAX ? text.substring(0, this.BODY_SNIPPET_MAX) + '…' : text
    },

    /**
     * Mint a Dell OAuth client_credentials token.
     * Returns `{ok, httpStatus, token, message, snippet}`. The token is used
     * in-process only and is never persisted or returned to the client.
     */
    _mintToken: function () {
        var credentials = this._credentialState()
        if (!credentials.exists) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: 0,
                token: '',
                message: 'The "' + this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME + '" basic auth profile does not exist on this instance.',
            }
        }
        if (!credentials.clientId || !credentials.hasSecret) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: 0,
                token: '',
                message: 'Dell API credentials are not configured yet. Save a client id and client secret first.',
            }
        }

        var profile = this._authProfile()
        var clientId = this._str0(profile.getValue('username'))
        var clientSecret = this._decryptSecret(profile)

        try {
            var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2()
            request.setEndpoint(this.TOKEN_ENDPOINT)
            request.setHttpMethod('POST')
            request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
            request.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json')
            request.setRequestBody(
                'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=' +
                    encodeURIComponent(clientId) +
                    '&client_secret=' +
                    encodeURIComponent(clientSecret)
            )
            request.setHttpTimeout(this.HTTP_TIMEOUT)

            var response = request.execute()
            var status = parseInt(response.getStatusCode(), 10)

            if (status !== 200) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    httpStatus: status,
                    token: '',
                    message: 'Dell rejected the token request (HTTP ' + status + ').',
                    snippet: this._safeSnippet(response.getBody()),
                }
            }

            var token = ''
            try {
                token = this._str(JSON.parse(response.getBody()).access_token).trim()
            } catch (jsonError) {
                token = ''
            }

            if (!token) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    httpStatus: status,
                    token: '',
                    message: 'Dell returned HTTP 200 but the response contained no access_token.',
                }
            }
            return { ok: true, httpStatus: status, token: token, message: 'Access token received from Dell.' }
        } catch (tokenException) {
            // The exception text is logged, never the request body or secret.
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Guided Setup: token request exception - ' + tokenException)
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: 0,
                token: '',
                message: 'The token request could not be completed. See the system log for details.',
            }
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 1. checkPrerequisites()
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Verify that everything the integration depends on is present.
     * @return array of `{key, label, status: 'pass'|'fail', detail}`
     */
    checkPrerequisites: function () {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var checks = []

        // --- staging table -------------------------------------------------
        var stageValid = false
        try {
            stageValid = new GlideRecord(this.STAGE_TABLE).isValid()
        } catch (stageError) {
            stageValid = false
        }
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'stage_table',
                'Staging table ' + this.STAGE_TABLE,
                stageValid,
                stageValid ? 'Table exists.' : 'Table ' + this.STAGE_TABLE + ' was not found.'
            )
        )

        // --- alm_hardware custom columns -----------------------------------
        var missing = []
        for (var i = 0; i < this.ASSET_COLUMNS.length; i++) {
            var dictionary = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary')
            dictionary.addQuery('name', this.ASSET_TABLE)
            dictionary.addQuery('element', this.ASSET_COLUMNS[i])
            dictionary.setLimit(1)
            dictionary.query()
            if (!dictionary.next()) {
                missing.push(this.ASSET_COLUMNS[i])
            }
        }
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'asset_columns',
                'Warranty columns on ' + this.ASSET_TABLE,
                missing.length === 0,
                missing.length === 0
                    ? 'All ' + this.ASSET_COLUMNS.length + ' columns are present.'
                    : 'Missing column(s): ' + missing.join(', ')
            )
        )

        // --- application role ----------------------------------------------
        var roleExists = this._exists('sys_user_role', 'name', this.APP_ROLE)
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'role',
                'Role ' + this.APP_ROLE,
                roleExists,
                roleExists ? 'Role exists.' : 'Role ' + this.APP_ROLE + ' was not found.'
            )
        )

        // --- basic auth profile --------------------------------------------
        var profileExists = this._exists(this.AUTH_PROFILE_TABLE, 'name', this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME)
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'auth_profile',
                'Basic auth profile "' + this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME + '"',
                profileExists,
                profileExists
                    ? 'Profile exists. Credential values are reported separately by credentialsConfigured.'
                    : 'Profile was not found.'
            )
        )

        // --- REST message + get function ------------------------------------
        var messageSysId = ''
        var message = new GlideRecord('sys_rest_message')
        message.addQuery('name', this.REST_MESSAGE)
        message.setLimit(1)
        message.query()
        if (message.next()) {
            messageSysId = this._str(message.getUniqueValue())
        }
        var functionExists = false
        if (messageSysId) {
            var fn = new GlideRecord('sys_rest_message_fn')
            fn.addQuery('rest_message', messageSysId)
            fn.addQuery('function_name', this.REST_FUNCTION)
            fn.setLimit(1)
            fn.query()
            functionExists = fn.next()
        }
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'rest_message',
                'REST message "' + this.REST_MESSAGE + '" and function "' + this.REST_FUNCTION + '"',
                !!messageSysId && functionExists,
                !messageSysId
                    ? 'REST message was not found.'
                    : functionExists
                      ? 'Message and function are both present.'
                      : 'Message exists but the "' + this.REST_FUNCTION + '" function was not found.'
            )
        )

        // --- scheduled job --------------------------------------------------
        var jobExists = this._exists(this.JOB_TABLE, 'name', this.JOB_NAME)
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'scheduled_job',
                'Scheduled job "' + this.JOB_NAME + '"',
                jobExists,
                jobExists ? 'Job exists.' : 'Job was not found.'
            )
        )

        // --- sync script include --------------------------------------------
        var syncExists = this._exists('sys_script_include', 'name', this.SYNC_INCLUDE)
        checks.push(
            this._check(
                'sync_include',
                'Script include ' + this.SYNC_INCLUDE,
                syncExists,
                syncExists ? 'Sync engine is installed.' : 'Script include ' + this.SYNC_INCLUDE + ' was not found.'
            )
        )

        return checks
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 2. getStatus()
    // ==================================================================

    /** Everything the wizard needs for one render pass. Contains NO secrets. */
    getStatus: function () {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var prerequisites = this.checkPrerequisites()
        var credentials = this._credentialState()
        var state = this._readState()

        var job = { sys_id: '', active: false, run_time: '' }
        var jobRecord = new GlideRecord(this.JOB_TABLE)
        jobRecord.addQuery('name', this.JOB_NAME)
        jobRecord.setLimit(1)
        jobRecord.query()
        if (jobRecord.next()) {
            job.sys_id = this._str(jobRecord.getUniqueValue())
            job.active = jobRecord.getValue('active') === '1' || jobRecord.getValue('active') === 'true'
            job.run_time = this._str(jobRecord.getDisplayValue('run_time'))
        }

        // Presence only. The alias is structural; it is NOT in the runtime path.
        var alias = { exists: false, name: this.CONNECTION_ALIAS }
        var aliasRecord = new GlideRecord('sys_alias')
        aliasRecord.addQuery('name', this.CONNECTION_ALIAS)
        aliasRecord.setLimit(1)
        aliasRecord.query()
        alias.exists = aliasRecord.next()

        var restMessage = new GlideRecord('sys_rest_message')
        restMessage.addQuery('name', this.REST_MESSAGE)
        restMessage.setLimit(1)
        restMessage.query()
        var restMessageSysId = restMessage.next() ? this._str(restMessage.getUniqueValue()) : ''

        return {
            ok: true,
            prerequisites: prerequisites,
            credentialsConfigured: credentials.exists && !!credentials.clientId && credentials.hasSecret,
            clientIdMasked: this._maskClientId(credentials.clientId),
            job: job,
            properties: {
                daily_limit: this._intProp(this.PROP_DAILY_LIMIT, 1000),
                batch_size: this._intProp(this.PROP_BATCH_SIZE, 100),
                stale_days: this._intProp(this.PROP_STALE_DAYS, 30),
                notify: this._str0(gs.getProperty(this.PROP_NOTIFY, '')),
            },
            setupState: this._str0(state.state) || 'not_started',
            lastConnectionTest: state.lastConnectionTest || null,
            lastApiTest: state.lastApiTest || null,
            completedBy: this._str0(state.completedBy),
            completedOn: this._str0(state.completedOn),
            connectionAlias: alias,
            stageCounts: {
                total: this._count(''),
                pending: this._count('u_status=Pending'),
                transformed: this._count('u_status=Transformed'),
                error: this._count('u_status=Error - no match'),
            },
            links: {
                workspace: '/now/dell-warranty/home',
                dashboard:
                    '/now/platform-analytics-workspace/dashboards/params/edit/false/sys-id/' + this.DASHBOARD_SYS_ID,
                stage: '/' + this.STAGE_TABLE + '_list.do',
                job: job.sys_id ? '/' + this.JOB_TABLE + '.do?sys_id=' + job.sys_id : '/' + this.JOB_TABLE + '_list.do',
                restMessage: restMessageSysId
                    ? '/sys_rest_message.do?sys_id=' + restMessageSysId
                    : '/sys_rest_message_list.do',
            },
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 3. saveCredentials()
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Write the Dell client id (username) and, when supplied, the client
     * secret (password) onto the basic auth profile.
     *
     * A BLANK/OMITTED `clientSecret` leaves the stored secret UNTOUCHED, so an
     * admin can correct a typo in the client id without having to re-enter the
     * secret. The returned message says which of the two happened. Neither
     * value is ever logged, and the secret is never echoed back.
     */
    saveCredentials: function (clientId, clientSecret) {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var id = this._str0(clientId)
        var secret = this._str0(clientSecret)

        if (!id) {
            return { ok: false, message: 'Provide the Dell TechDirect client id.' }
        }

        var profile = this._authProfile()
        if (!profile) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                message:
                    'The "' +
                    this.AUTH_PROFILE_NAME +
                    '" basic auth profile does not exist on this instance, so there is nowhere to store the credentials.',
            }
        }

        var hadSecret = !!this._decryptSecret(profile)

        profile.setValue('username', id)
        if (secret) {
            profile.setValue('password', secret)
        }

        if (!profile.update()) {
            return { ok: false, message: 'The credential record could not be updated.' }
        }

        this._markInProgress()

        return {
            ok: true,
            message: secret
                ? 'Client id and client secret saved.'
                : hadSecret
                  ? 'Client id saved. No client secret was supplied, so the existing stored secret was left unchanged.'
                  : 'Client id saved. No client secret was supplied and none is stored yet — enter one to finish this step.',
            clientIdMasked: this._maskClientId(id),
            credentialsConfigured: !!id && (secret ? true : hadSecret),
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 4. testConnection()
    // ==================================================================

    /** POST the Dell token endpoint and report the outcome. */
    testConnection: function () {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var result = this._mintToken()

        var state = this._readState()
        state.lastConnectionTest = this._stamp(result.ok)
        if (state.state !== 'complete') {
            state.state = 'in_progress'
        }
        this._writeState(state)

        return {
            ok: result.ok,
            httpStatus: result.httpStatus,
            tokenReceived: result.ok,
            message: result.message,
            // Scrubbed, capped body snippet — only present on failure.
            detail: result.ok ? '' : this._str(result.snippet),
        }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 5. testWarrantyApi()
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Mint a token, then call the "Dell Warranty API" / `get` function for a
     * single service tag.
     *
     * `persistStageRow` must be EXPLICITLY true to write a staging row, and
     * when it is, the work is DELEGATED to
     * `new DellWarrantySync().runForTags([tag], true)` so the clamping,
     * entitlement summarisation, column mapping and transform stay in exactly
     * one place. This method never duplicates staging or transform logic.
     */
    testWarrantyApi: function (serviceTag, persistStageRow) {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var tag = this._str0(serviceTag)
        if (!tag || !this.SERVICE_TAG_PATTERN.test(tag)) {
            // Dell is NOT called for a blank or malformed tag.
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: 0,
                serviceTag: tag,
                message: 'Provide a 7-character alphanumeric Dell service tag.',
            }
        }

        var token = this._mintToken()
        if (!token.ok) {
            this._recordApiTest(false)
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: token.httpStatus,
                serviceTag: tag,
                message: 'Could not mint a bearer token, so the warranty API was not called. ' + token.message,
                detail: this._str(token.snippet),
            }
        }

        try {
            var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(this.REST_MESSAGE, this.REST_FUNCTION)
            rm.setStringParameterNoEscape('servicetags', tag)
            rm.setStringParameterNoEscape('authToken', token.token)
            rm.setHttpTimeout(this.HTTP_TIMEOUT)

            var response = rm.execute()
            var status = parseInt(response.getStatusCode(), 10)

            if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
                this._recordApiTest(false)
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    httpStatus: status,
                    serviceTag: tag,
                    entitlementCount: 0,
                    model: '',
                    message: 'Dell returned HTTP ' + status + ' for service tag ' + tag + '.',
                    detail: this._safeSnippet(response.getBody()),
                }
            }

            var items = []
            try {
                var parsed = JSON.parse(response.getBody())
                if (parsed instanceof Array) {
                    items = parsed
                } else if (parsed && parsed.AssetWarrantyResponse instanceof Array) {
                    items = parsed.AssetWarrantyResponse
                } else if (parsed) {
                    items = [parsed]
                }
            } catch (jsonError) {
                items = []
            }

            if (!items.length) {
                this._recordApiTest(false)
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    httpStatus: status,
                    serviceTag: tag,
                    entitlementCount: 0,
                    model: '',
                    message: 'Dell returned HTTP ' + status + ' but no asset entry for service tag ' + tag + '.',
                }
            }

            var item = items[0] || {}
            var sync = new DellWarrantySync()
            // Read-only reuse of the sync engine's summariser for the response.
            var entitlements = sync._summarizeEntitlements(item)
            var model = this._str(item.productLineDescription || item.productId || item.machineDescription)

            var staged = false
            if (persistStageRow === true) {
                // DELEGATE staging + transform to the sync engine (force=true
                // so the same-day duplicate guard does not block a deliberate
                // test). No staging logic is reimplemented here.
                var stats = new DellWarrantySync().runForTags([tag], true)
                staged = !!stats && stats.staged > 0
            }

            this._recordApiTest(true)

            return {
                ok: true,
                httpStatus: status,
                serviceTag: tag,
                entitlementCount: entitlements.count,
                warrantyStart: entitlements.start,
                warrantyExpiration: entitlements.end,
                model: model,
                stageRowCreated: staged,
                message:
                    'Dell returned ' +
                    entitlements.count +
                    ' entitlement(s) for ' +
                    tag +
                    (persistStageRow === true
                        ? staged
                            ? '. A staging row was created and transformed by DellWarrantySync.'
                            : '. No staging row could be created — see the system log.'
                        : '. No staging row was created.'),
            }
        } catch (apiException) {
            gs.error('Dell Warranty Guided Setup: warranty lookup exception - ' + apiException)
            this._recordApiTest(false)
            return {
                ok: false,
                httpStatus: 0,
                serviceTag: tag,
                entitlementCount: 0,
                model: '',
                message: 'The warranty lookup could not be completed. See the system log for details.',
            }
        }
    },

    /** Persist the last warranty-API test outcome into the setup state. */
    _recordApiTest: function (ok) {
        var state = this._readState()
        state.lastApiTest = this._stamp(ok)
        if (state.state !== 'complete') {
            state.state = 'in_progress'
        }
        this._writeState(state)
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 6. setJobActive()
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Flip `active` on the "Dell Warranty Daily Import" scheduled job.
     *
     * GUARD: activation is REFUSED unless every prerequisite passes, the
     * credentials are configured, AND the last connection test succeeded.
     * Activating a job that cannot authenticate would only produce a nightly
     * run of failed token requests. DEACTIVATION is always permitted.
     */
    setJobActive: function (active) {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var wantActive = active === true

        if (wantActive) {
            var blockers = []

            var prerequisites = this.checkPrerequisites()
            for (var i = 0; i < prerequisites.length; i++) {
                if (prerequisites[i].status !== 'pass') {
                    blockers.push('prerequisite "' + prerequisites[i].label + '" is failing')
                }
            }

            var credentials = this._credentialState()
            if (!credentials.exists || !credentials.clientId || !credentials.hasSecret) {
                blockers.push('Dell API credentials are not configured')
            }

            var state = this._readState()
            if (!state.lastConnectionTest || state.lastConnectionTest.ok !== true) {
                blockers.push('the connection test has not succeeded yet')
            }

            if (blockers.length) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    active: this._jobActive(),
                    message: 'The daily import cannot be activated yet: ' + blockers.join('; ') + '.',
                }
            }
        }

        var job = new GlideRecord(this.JOB_TABLE)
        job.addQuery('name', this.JOB_NAME)
        job.setLimit(1)
        job.query()
        if (!job.next()) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                active: false,
                message: 'The "' + this.JOB_NAME + '" scheduled job was not found.',
            }
        }

        job.setValue('active', wantActive)
        if (!job.update()) {
            return { ok: false, active: this._jobActive(), message: 'The scheduled job could not be updated.' }
        }

        this._markInProgress()

        return {
            ok: true,
            active: wantActive,
            message: wantActive
                ? 'The Dell Warranty Daily Import job is now active.'
                : 'The Dell Warranty Daily Import job is now inactive.',
        }
    },

    /** Current `active` flag on the job. */
    _jobActive: function () {
        var job = new GlideRecord(this.JOB_TABLE)
        job.addQuery('name', this.JOB_NAME)
        job.setLimit(1)
        job.query()
        if (!job.next()) {
            return false
        }
        return job.getValue('active') === '1' || job.getValue('active') === 'true'
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 7. setProperty()
    // ==================================================================

    /** Update ONE whitelisted Dell warranty property. */
    setProperty: function (name, value) {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var propertyName = this._str0(name)
        var expectedType = this.WRITABLE_PROPERTIES[propertyName]

        if (!expectedType) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                message:
                    'Property "' +
                    propertyName +
                    '" is not editable from the guided setup. Editable properties: ' +
                    Object.keys(this.WRITABLE_PROPERTIES).join(', ') +
                    '.',
            }
        }

        var raw = this._str(value).trim()

        if (expectedType === 'integer') {
            if (!/^\d+$/.test(raw) || parseInt(raw, 10) <= 0) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    message: propertyName + ' must be a whole number greater than zero.',
                }
            }
            raw = String(parseInt(raw, 10))
        }

        gs.setProperty(propertyName, raw)
        this._markInProgress()

        return { ok: true, name: propertyName, value: raw, message: propertyName + ' updated.' }
    },

    // ==================================================================
    // 8. markComplete() / resetSetup()
    // ==================================================================

    /**
     * Stamp the setup as complete. Requires all prerequisites to pass, the
     * credentials to be configured, and a successful connection test.
     */
    markComplete: function () {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var blockers = []

        var prerequisites = this.checkPrerequisites()
        for (var i = 0; i < prerequisites.length; i++) {
            if (prerequisites[i].status !== 'pass') {
                blockers.push('prerequisite "' + prerequisites[i].label + '" is failing')
            }
        }

        var credentials = this._credentialState()
        if (!credentials.exists || !credentials.clientId || !credentials.hasSecret) {
            blockers.push('Dell API credentials are not configured')
        }

        var current = this._readState()
        if (!current.lastConnectionTest || current.lastConnectionTest.ok !== true) {
            blockers.push('the connection test has not succeeded yet')
        }

        if (blockers.length) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                setupState: this._str0(current.state) || 'not_started',
                message: 'The guided setup cannot be marked complete yet: ' + blockers.join('; ') + '.',
            }
        }

        current.state = 'complete'
        current.completedBy = this._str(gs.getUserName())
        current.completedOn = new GlideDateTime().getValue()
        var saved = this._writeState(current)

        return {
            ok: true,
            setupState: saved.state,
            completedBy: saved.completedBy,
            completedOn: saved.completedOn,
            message: 'Dell Warranty guided setup marked complete.',
        }
    },

    /** Clear the setup state back to "not started". Keeps credentials intact. */
    resetSetup: function () {
        var refusal = this._requireAdmin()
        if (refusal) {
            return refusal
        }

        var saved = this._writeState({ state: 'not_started' })
        return {
            ok: true,
            setupState: saved.state,
            message: 'Dell Warranty guided setup state reset. Credentials and the job schedule were not changed.',
        }
    },

    type: 'DellWarrantyGuidedSetup',
}

'Saving…' : 'Save'} disabled={busy} onClick={save} />\n </div>\n <ResultAlert result={result} successHeader={`${label} saved`} />\n </div>\n )\n}\n","import React, { useState } from 'react'\nimport FactList from './FactList'\nimport PropertyField from './PropertyField'\nimport ResultAlert from './ResultAlert'\nimport { AlertBox, Btn, Lnk } from './Ui'\nimport { ApiResult, setJobActive } from '../services/setup'\nimport { ActionPayload } from '../types'\nimport { StepProps } from './stepProps'\nimport { display } from '../utils/fields'\nimport { activationBlockers } from '../utils/steps'\n\nexport default function Step6Job({ status, refresh }: StepProps) {\n const [result, setResult] = useState<ApiResult<ActionPayload> | null>(null)\n const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)\n\n const blockers = activationBlockers(status)\n const canActivate = blockers.length === 0\n const active = status?.job?.active === true\n\n const toggle = async (next: boolean) => {\n setBusy(true)\n setResult(await setJobActive(next))\n await refresh()\n setBusy(false)\n }\n\n return (\n <section className=\"dwgs__step-body\">\n <p>\n The <strong>Dell Warranty Daily Import</strong> job runs the tiered import: assets with no warranty\n date first, then coverage expiring within 90 days, then stale TechDirect-tagged assets.\n </p>\n <FactList\n facts={[\n { label: 'Job state', value: active ? 'not_started'\n const isComplete = state === 'complete'\n const blockers = activationBlockers(status)\n const canComplete = blockers.length === 0\n\n const finish = async () => {\n setBusy(true)\n setResult(await markComplete())\n await refresh()\n setBusy(false)\n }\n\n const counts = status?.stageCounts\n const links = status?.links\n\n return (\n <section className=\"dwgs__step-body\">\n <FactList\n facts={[\n { label: 'Setup state', value: STATE_TEXT[state] ?? state },\n { label: 'Completed by', value: display(status?.completedBy) || 'Not recorded' },\n { label: 'Completed on', value: display(status?.completedOn) || 'Not recorded' },\n ]}\n />\n\n <h3 className=\"dwgs__subheading\">Staging activity</h3>\n <FactList\n facts={[\n { label: 'Total staged rows', value: display(counts?.total) || '0' },\n { label: 'Pending', value: display(counts?.pending) || '0' },\n { label: 'Transformed', value: display(counts?.transformed) || '0' },\n { label: 'Error - no match', value: display(counts?.error) || '0' },\n ]}\n />\n <AlertBox tone=\"info\" header=\"Zero staged rows is expected before the first run\">\n Staging rows only appear once the daily job or a warranty test has run with real Dell credentials.\n Rows with status <code>Error - no match</code> are service tags Dell returned that match no Dell\n asset here, which is normal and not an integration fault.\n </AlertBox>\n\n {!isComplete && !canComplete && (\n <AlertBox tone=\"warning\" header=\"Not ready to mark complete\">\n {`Before setup can be marked complete, ${blockers.join('; ')}.`}\n </AlertBox>\n )}\n\n <div className=\"dwgs__actions\">\n <Btn\n label={isComplete ?
