THIS IS LOAD-BEARING.\n * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n * The previous version rendered its fallback with `Alert` from\n * @servicenow/react-components — the very component family that was throwing.\n * When a boundary's fallback also throws, React cannot recover and unmounts the\n * entire tree, so the page went completely blank with no message anywhere. That\n * turned a one-component bug into a total outage and hid the cause.\n *\n * The fallback below is plain HTML and inline styles only: no imports, no\n * design-token lookups, no CSS class dependencies. It renders even if the\n * stylesheet failed to load and even if every component library is broken.\n *\n * The message is also written to `document.title`, because on a restricted\n * instance the operator often has no browser console, and the tab title is a\n * channel that always survives.\n *\n * Must be a class component — `componentDidCatch` has no hook equivalent.\n */\nexport default class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {\n /**\n * Re-declared because under the mandated `jsx: \"preserve\"` client tsconfig\n * the React base-class generics do not resolve far enough for TypeScript to\n * infer `props`/`state`. `declare` emits no runtime field.\n */\n declare props: ErrorBoundaryProps\n declare state: ErrorBoundaryState\n\n constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {\n super(props)\n this.state = { message: '' }\n }\n\n static getDerivedStateFromError(error: unknown): ErrorBoundaryState {\n const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n return { message: message || 'Unknown render error' }\n }\n\n componentDidCatch(error: unknown) {\n const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n document.title = `Guided Setup error: ${message}`.slice(0, 180)\n }\n\n render() {\n if (this.state.message) {\n return (\n <div\n role=\"alert\"\n style={{\n border: '2px solid #e52239',\n borderRadius: '8px',\n padding: '16px',\n margin: '16px 0',\n background: '#fff',\n color: '#10171a',\n fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif',\n lineHeight: 1.4,\n }}\n >\n <strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '8px' }}>\n {this.props.label} could not be displayed\n </strong>\n <code style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '8px', wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>\n {this.state.message}\n </code>\n <span>\n The rest of the wizard is still usable — pick another step from the list. This message is\n also in the browser tab title.\n </span>\n </div>\n )\n }\n return this.props.children as React.ReactElement\n }\n}\n","import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'\nimport WizardShell from './components/WizardShell'\nimport Step1Prerequisites from './components/Step1Prerequisites'\nimport Step2Credentials from './components/Step2Credentials'\nimport Step3Connection from './components/Step3Connection'\nimport Step4WarrantyTest from './components/Step4WarrantyTest'\nimport Step5Outbound from './components/Step5Outbound'\nimport Step6Job from './components/Step6Job'\nimport Step7Finish from './components/Step7Finish'\nimport ErrorBoundary from './components/ErrorBoundary'\nimport { AlertBox } from './components/Ui'\nimport { FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE } from './components/ResultAlert'\nimport { useSetupStatus } from './hooks/useSetupStatus'\nimport { PAGE_TITLE, STEP_COUNT, STEP_TITLES, deriveStepStates } from './utils/steps'\nimport './styles.css'\n\n/** Read `?step=N`, clamped into range. Defaults to step 1. */\nfunction stepFromLocation(): number {\n const raw = parseInt(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('step') ?? '1', 10)\n if (isNaN(raw)) return 1\n return Math.min(Math.max(raw, 1), STEP_COUNT)\n}\n\n/**\n * Polaris keeps the browser tab title and the permalink in sync with the\n * embedded page, so announce the current step when running inside the shell.\n */\nfunction syncFrameTitle(step: number) {\n const title = `${PAGE_TITLE} \\u2014 Step ${step}: ${STEP_TITLES[step - 1]}`\n document.title = title\n if (window.self !== window.top) {\n try {\n window.parent.postMessage({ command: 'now_sow_title', title }, window.location.origin)\n } catch (error) {\n // Cross-origin parent: the in-page heading already conveys the step.\n }\n }\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n const [step, setStep] = useState(stepFromLocation)\n const { status, statusResult, loading, refresh } = useSetupStatus()\n\n // Browser back/forward must move between steps, never reload the page.\n useEffect(() => {\n const onPop = () => setStep(stepFromLocation())\n window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop)\n return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop)\n }, [])\n\n useEffect(() => syncFrameTitle(step), [step])\n\n const select = useCallback((next: number) => {\n const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(next, 1), STEP_COUNT)\n const url = new URL(window.location.href)\n url.searchParams.set('step', String(clamped))\n window.history.pushState({ step: clamped }, '', url)\n setStep(clamped)\n }, [])\n\n const stepProps = { status, refresh }\n\n const body = () => {\n if (statusResult?.forbidden) {\n return (\n <AlertBox tone=\"error\" header=\"Access denied\">\n {FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE}\n </AlertBox>\n )\n }\n if (!status && loading) {\n return (\n <AlertBox tone=\"info\" header=\"Loading\">\n Reading the current setup status…\n </AlertBox>\n )\n }\n if (!status) {\n // `payload` is typed as SetupStatus, but a failed call returns {ok,message}.\n const failure = statusResult?.payload as { message?: string } | undefined\n return (\n <AlertBox tone=\"error\" header=\"Could not read setup status\">\n {failure?.message ||\n 'The setup status endpoint did not respond. text is stripped from diagnostics, and\n * operators on a restricted instance often have no devtools). null>(null)\n const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n\n const refresh = useCallback(async () => {\n setLoading(true)\n const result = await fetchStatus()\n setStatusResult(result)\n if (result.ok && result.payload) setStatus(result.payload)\n setLoading(false)\n return result\n }, [])\n\n useEffect(() => {\n void refresh()\n }, [refresh])\n\n return { status, statusResult, loading,
